items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My association with Michael Cain was a highly creative one... we did Dancing With Nature Spirits and some co-written things by Mike Cain and myself.

ctx.x: This was done on ECM. My association with Michael Cain was a highly creative one, and after Special Edition disbanded I had this group together. Actually before the Oneness group formed there was a record we did that had the bamboo flutist and clarinet player… It should be in the records. It was with Mike Cain and…
About what year would that have been? Because I’m showing one that I hadn’t discussed, Dancing With Nature Spirits.
